name: JND Space Histogram Equalization for Transfer Function Generation
aliases: Automatic transfer function generation based on JND space histogram equalization
definition: A method to automatically generate a perceptually linear transfer function by performing histogram equalization on JND-corrected volume data, mapping interesting data into the visible range.
summary: JND Space Histogram Equalization automatically generates perceptually linear transfer functions by correcting volume data for human visual sensitivity before equalization, unlike standard methods that ignore non-linear perception.
